meta.title: The buyer has no Revoke on a vendor's bid
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with two bids directly on the buyer’s Responses tab.
Ensure RFQ counter-offer actions are available for the buyer.
Ensure the eRFX project configuration required by the setup is active.
Confirm the prepared first bidder is present as Vendor A’s bid context.
Verify the buyer can initiate a counter offer for Vendor A’s bid.
Verify the allowed Select action is available for Vendor A’s bid.
Verify the allowed Reject Bid action is available for Vendor A’s bid.
Assert that the buyer has no Revoke control for Vendor A’s submitted bid.
